name: Johnny's Pizza & Pasta Ristorante Italiano
hours: Tue to Thu 11:30 to 9:30. Fri and Sat 11 to 10. Closed Mon.
description: Johnny's Pizza & Pasta Ristorante Italiano in Spring Mount serves fine Italian cuisine, BYO comfort at reasonable family pricing: pizza, stromboli, grinders, and pasta, seafood, steak, and veal cooked one dish at a time.
tagline: Fine Italian cuisine, BYO comfort, reasonable family pricing
marquee: It's all about the food and service

story.heading: Truly a Ristorante Italiano
paragraphs: Johnny's takes pride in serving the finest pasta, seafood, and choicest cuts of steak and veal available, with dishes prepared one at a time to assure quality.
If your favorite dish is not on the menu, just ask. The comfort is BYO.

experience.heading: How dinner happens here
items: Call 610.287.4771 for home dining, delivery, take-out, or special arrangements.
Sit down on Main Street with your own wine, or check the delivery zone.
Join the newsletter for party tray promotions and coupons.

feature.heading: The Regular Stromboli
feature.text: The stromboli is an Italian-American creation with roots in the world of pizzacraft. Johnny's version is the one Spring Mount orders by name.

closing.heading: Fine Italian cuisine, BYO comfort at reasonable family pricing
